🤠 AUSTIN… ROUX IS MAKING ITS DEBUT. 🔥For the first time ever, ROUX is taking over Austin with a full BOLLYWOOD TAKEOVER ROOFTOP PARTY at Willow Country Bar Rooftop. 🌇🥂

This isn’t your regular night out.

We’re bringing together Bollywood, Afro House, Desi, and Hip-Hop for one high-energy rooftop experience in the heart of Austin.

Expect skyline views, a packed rooftop, nonstop music, and that signature ROUX energy from start to finish. 💃🏽🔥

THE VIBE🔥 Bollywood Anthems

🔥 Afro House

🔥 Desi Club Hits

🔥 Hip-Hop

🔥 Rooftop Energy

🔥 Austin Skyline Views

🔥 Full ROUX Takeover

EVENT DETAILSDATE: Friday, November 27, 2026

TIME: 10 PM

VENUE: Willow Country Bar Rooftop

ADDRESS: 719 W 6th St, Austin, TX 78701

This is our AUSTIN DEBUT — and we’re making it count. 👀

🎟️ Tickets are limited and prices may increase as tiers sell out.

AUSTIN… WELCOME TO ROUX. 🤠🔥

EVENT POLICIESAdmission is subject to venue capacity, security procedures, dress code, ID verification, and management discretion.

A valid government-issued photo ID is required for entry. Photos, screenshots, photocopies, or expired identification may be refused.

ROUX maintains a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, unwanted touching, fighting, threatening behavior, discrimination, property damage, or conduct that disrupts the safety or enjoyment of other guests.

Guests removed by security or denied entry for violating venue policies will not be eligible for a refund.

Photography and videography may take place throughout the event. By attending, guests acknowledge that they may appear in promotional media used by ROUX, the venue, and affiliated partners.

ALL SALES ARE FINAL AND NON-REFUNDABLE.

No refunds, cancellations, credits, exchanges, or transfers will be provided unless the event is cancelled by the organizer.
